name_en: Phase transition in the Erdos-Renyi random graph
category: probability and stochastic processes / stochastic processes
canonical_claim: For the sparse Erdos-Renyi random graph G(n,p) with p asymptotic to c/n, component sizes undergo a transition at c = 1: in the subcritical regime c < 1 every component is small, whereas in the supercritical regime c > 1 there is a unique component of linear order and all remaining components are small; exact asymptotic bounds, probability modes, and the treatment of c = 1 must be fixed from an inspected primary theorem before formalization.
